wins.label: North America Strong Recovery
wins.evidence: North America Q2 revenue grew 9%, wholesale grew 24%, and we're seeing momentum extend beyond Running into basketball and training

wins.label: Running Business Momentum
wins.evidence: Running grew by over 20% for the second quarter in a row, it's up double digits in every channel, including NIKE Direct

wins.label: Wholesale Return to Growth
wins.evidence: Wholesale grew 8% this quarter, with a growing order book globally in both spring and summer

wins.label: Marketplace Cleanup Progress
wins.evidence: Classics footwear franchises are on track to decline from peak levels by more than $4 billion by fiscal year-end, inventory is in a healthy and clean position in North America and EMEA

wins.label: Product Innovation Pipeline
wins.evidence: Order book is improving season on season, booking units in Football are nearly 40% higher than World Cup '22

risks.label: Greater China Severe Decline
risks.evidence: Greater China Q2 revenue declined 16%, EBIT declined 49% on a reported basis, we expect headwinds to continue for the balance of the fiscal year

risks.label: Tariff Headwinds
risks.evidence: We are navigating new structural headwinds from the $1.5 billion of annualized incremental product costs due to higher U.S. tariffs, representing a gross headwind of approximately 320 basis points to gross margin in fiscal '26

risks.label: Margin Pressure Persists
risks.evidence: Gross margins declined 300 basis points to 40.6%, we see the path back to double-digit EBIT margins but it will take time

risks.label: NIKE Digital Weakness
risks.evidence: NIKE Digital declining 14% overall, down 16% in North America and down 36% in Greater China

risks.label: Non-Linear Recovery Timeline
risks.evidence: Our comeback continues to move at different speeds, it won't be a straight line, each brand, sport and geography is recovering on a different time line
